name: sql_database_agent
description: Enterprise database assistant built on LangChain and LangGraph. Executes read-only SQL queries against user account databases, strictly governed by Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval and automated PII redaction (Credit Cards & Emails).

skills.name: Secure Read-Only SQL Querying
skills.description: Executes SELECT queries against users database and returns tabular reports.

skills.name: HITL Verification & PII Redaction
skills.description: Interrupts queries for human approval and automatically redacts credit cards and emails.
examples: Verify authorization for financial data queries
